snippet.title: How Restaurants Use AI to Watch Every Table in Real Time
snippet.description: Instead of paying someone to watch the floor, restaurants run computer vision on every table. Green: open and ready. Red: guests are seated and a countdown starts. snippet.title: What happens when 12 AI agents edit one file? #ai #tech #experiment
snippet.description:
Fixing AI agent conflicts when running multiple processes at once. Learn how to stop data loss and vanishing assets.

We look at the underlying file structures and asset loading logic required to keep your workspace stable. By separating permissions for each agent, you prevent the data overwrites that break your scene. This workflow is for creators building automation systems who need to maintain data integrity while scaling their parallel operations.
